mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (current level) compresses discount rates applied to equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI (Consumer Price Index) above 202.0 (as of t-1mo) signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 202.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by > 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% and the level of payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 (thousands, meaning 100,000,000 persons), it signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 100000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level compresses the risk of supply chain disruptions and supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1400.0 (thousands) signals weak consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A high real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL > 2.0) compresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL > 2.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 11500.0 billion and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0 (thousands), it signals a strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 > 11500.0 and HOUST > 1500.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03
